name: diy-shed
author: hearn1
description: Locally-hosted app that ranks your DIY projects by effort and out-of-pocket cost.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm -w server run start
scripts.electron: npm run build && npm run electron:rebuild && electron electron/main.js
scripts.test: npm -w server run test && npm -w client run test
